query:
DELETE FROM crm_user_mappings
         WHERE organization_id = $1
           AND provider = $2::text::crm_provider
           AND crm_tenant_id = $3
           AND crm_principal_id = $4
           AND source = 'EMAIL_MATCH'::crm_user_mapping_source
           AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR user_id <> $5)
